whenToUse: Dashboard, settings and status sections with a title bar, card panels and a footer line
Lists of services, records or log entries joined into one stacked column of bordered panels
A titled shell around other parts, such as a collapsible run step that opens to its instructions

whenNotToUse.when: Several sections that each expand and collapse, one or many open at a time
Ready made KPI tiles, profile summaries or promo offers laid out across a page
A storefront page of items with photos, prices, swatches and wishlist toggles

agentNotes: `dense` strips the padding and gap of `Frame` itself and pulls each `FramePanel` onto the outer border; the panels keep their own padding
`stacked` joins only `FramePanel` elements that are adjacent direct children of `Frame`; a wrapper around one leaves both fully rounded and bordered
`FramePanel` grows into any spare height of `Frame`; pass `fit` when a panel should keep the height of its own content
